pairedGates.critical: Preserve every matched incumbent critical pass.
pairedGates.paired-evidence: Require an exact one-sided sign-test tail at most 1/4 as a selection heuristic.
pairedGates.paired-win-ratio: Require at least one paired win and at least twice as many wins as losses.

plan.scope: Retrospective comparison of archived decisions at the original search cap. Both archive and fresh qualification use the same gate. Final holdout never guides selection.
